candidate.definition_en: Of or situated on the inside; existing within an organization or country.
candidate.explanation_ar: داخلي.. حاجة جوه الشيء أو جوه المؤسسة، مش ظاهرة للناس اللي بره.

senses.definition_en: Situated on or inside the body or an object.
senses.definition_ar: داخلي؛ موجود في باطن الجسم أو في الجزء الداخلي لشيء ما.
examples: The doctor was worried about internal bleeding after the accident.

senses.definition_en: Existing or occurring within an organization, group, or country.
senses.definition_ar: داخلي؛ يحدث أو يعمل داخل منظومة أو مؤسسة أو دولة معينة.
examples: The company conducted an internal investigation into the incident.
We use an internal messaging system to communicate with colleagues.
The doctor was worried about internal bleeding after the accident.
The company conducted an internal investigation into the incident.
We use an internal messaging system to communicate with colleagues.
candidate.mnemonic: شبه 'Enter' 'يدخل'.. الـ 'Internal' هو الحاجة اللي جوه بعد ما تعمل Enter
